config.scope: Retrospective development audit over original train and validation recordings only. Previously inspected data and informed model family choices; not a fresh holdout or a future-time/unseen-machine benchmark.
config.splitter: GroupKFold with shuffle=True, random_state=42; whole overlap groups, not individual readings. Same seed for every inner split.
config.infeasible_fallback: If no point satisfies all recall floors, maximize the minimum capped ratio of achieved recall to each required recall floor, then precision, then minimize false-onset frequency, then recall. Disclose infeasibility. Do not change constraints or discard the outer fold.
config.final_refit: None. Save outer-fold models for reproducibility, no deployment or activation.
config.reporting: All fixed procedures: confusion counts, F0.5, precision, recall, FPR, onsets, sample exposure, availability, missed groups, events and delay. Raw-score AP per group and within each outer fold; do not rank pooled cross-fold probabilities. Test CSVs excluded.
config.hypothesis: Separate the effect of F0.5 alert selection from classifier changes using identical causal relative features and recording groups.
config.selection: HGB historical control retains recall floors and fallback. All other procedures maximize inner OOF F0.5 without recall floors; ties: precision, fewer false onsets per available normal hour, recall, higher threshold. CatBoost depth is selected only inside each outer training pool. No cross-family outer-score winner is activated. Numeric thresholds break ties only within one model; exact metric ties between CatBoost candidates follow the declared order (depth4 first).
config.false_positive_exposure: One second per false-positive sample, consistent with the existing SKAB exposure convention. A proxy, not reconstructed wall-clock alarm duration across gaps.
